knowledge-discovery.title: Discover published knowledge
knowledge-discovery.intro: Find published memory, specifications and skills in this project. Preview the exact revision before explicitly choosing how to use it.
knowledge-discovery.query_hint: Up to 200 UTF-8 bytes. Leave blank to browse; typing does not call a model or search.
knowledge-discovery.index_query_hint: Index search requires a query of 1–200 UTF-8 bytes. Select Find to use the configured index; unavailable indexes never fall back silently.
knowledge-discovery.invalid_index_query: Index search requires a non-empty query of up to 200 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters, and a valid project and type.
knowledge-discovery.invalid_index_respon: Index results do not match the exact publication, location or current reading contract. Read again.
knowledge-discovery.dirty: Filters changed. Select Find to read publications within the new scope.
knowledge-discovery.stale: These are previous results and have not been rechecked. Preview is unavailable until a successful read.
knowledge-discovery.access_denied: Current access to this scope is unavailable. Previous results were cleared. Read again to check access.
knowledge-discovery.view_required: Waiting for the current account, organization and project.
knowledge-discovery.invalid_query: The query scope is invalid. Keywords allow up to 200 UTF-8 bytes and no control characters.
knowledge-discovery.invalid_response: Publication results do not match the current scope or reading contract. Read again.
knowledge-discovery.empty: No matching published knowledge was found in this traversal
knowledge-discovery.empty_hint: Adjust the keywords or type. This does not mean the project has no drafts, historical knowledge or knowledge currently ineligible for new use.
knowledge-discovery.continuing: This page has no matches, but candidates remain unchecked. Continue finding.
knowledge-discovery.exhausted: This traversal reached its end. Publication and source eligibility are still checked on current reads.
knowledge-discovery.scanned: Latest page checked {{scanned}} / {{limit}} candidates; {{count}} items are displayed.
knowledge-discovery.matched.title: Title match
knowledge-discovery.index_candidates: Provider candidates: {{examined}} rechecked, {{discarded}} discarded; {{count}} eligible hits displayed.
knowledge-discovery.index_coverage: These facts describe this provider's candidates and local operations. They do not establish complete project coverage or gap-free delivery.
knowledge-discovery.index_empty: No eligible hits among these provider candidates
knowledge-discovery.index_empty_hint: Adjust the query or type, or inspect delivery status. This does not mean the project has no published knowledge or that the index is fully caught up.
knowledge-discovery.boundary: Search only opens an exact published revision. Adoption and actual model use remain separate; index availability, delivery status and query coverage are independent facts.
